arm.role: the sealed flight: every arm below is a column of it

aa.role: the in-flight twin: replicate_of lock, the null of every contrast

lock.role: the delivering arm: LEFT of every contrast (the locked template, untemplated)

boundary: A development read on a TRAIN fold (owner decisions 28 and 86); never a test claim; node-local, never a system-level claim. No utterance text, transcript, gold label or model output is printed or persisted.
decision_rule: SAME-FLIGHT NODE-TEMPLATE COLUMN READ (NX programme C0.2/C2 R1; instrument E1/E2; claim ceiling 'nominated'). One flight, one Solver visit per row, seven arms over the SAME QueryState and evidence: r1-c1 .. r1-c5 (hand-written candidates), aa (the twin, replicate_of lock) and lock (the locked template, delivering, last). Each arm's RAW first answer is read through the E2 reader (scripts/analysis/slurp_nx_solver_column_read.py): node-local primary = raw first-answer entity exact-set per row, paired per row against lock, with the whole-utterance cluster bootstrap CI95 (10,000 draws, seed 20260915) and the paired Wilson share of the discordant rows; secondaries parse_valid, empty_gold_false_fill, nonempty_exact and per-slot-type counts. Each arm's column is also rendered through the delivered row's normaliser and projection and scored ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train (never sharded); official contrasts are paired ROW bootstraps (cluster key sample_id, the stage3_paired_read constraint for column arms, 10,000 draws, seed 20260915), the whole-utterance number beside. (1) THE TWIN NULL: aa minus lock on every metric; the bar = |aa - lock offset| + its CI95 half-width, reported beside the design's provisional floor (SLU-F1 1.49 pp, intent 0.65 pp at n = 1,080; borrowed from same-flight-supply-variant until this cell measures its own null). (2) THE CONTRAST per candidate X: NOMINATED iff (a) the node-local exact-set CI95 lower bound > 0, AND (b) no secondary loss (parse_valid or nonempty_exact lower, or empty_gold_false_fill higher, with a CI95 excluding zero), AND (c) the intent guard holds: rows whose official intent correctness differs from lock <= 7 (0.65 pp of 1,080) or the official intent delta CI95 contains zero, AND (d) the official pooled SLU-F1 point delta exceeds the twin's SLU bar. HARM iff (a') the exact-set CI95 upper bound < 0. Among several NOMINATED arms the best node-local point estimate wins (ties: fewer words). PLATEAU RULE (programme C0.4): two evaluated rounds without a NOMINATED arm lock the delivering template and close the node. A nomination is confirmed once on TRAIN Fold A as a two-arm column before any lock; it admits nothing by itself. The delivering lock arm's own offline post-processing columns v4 and v4g are read beside (analysis recipe, offline_columns).

bootstrap.unit: row (paired); the whole-utterance number is the node-local and offline reads' own

v4.definition: the five-rule set of docs/results/2026-10-09-slurp-nx-postprocessing-v4-offline-read.md section 6, in the registered order

v4g.definition: v4 with the two TRAIN-only guards ee-wilson and ti-expressible of docs/results/2026-10-09-slurp-nx-postprocessing-v4-audio-attribution.md section 4

offline_columns.driver_interface_status: the rule definitions and their offline selection live in scripts/analysis/slurp_nx_postproc_v4_search.py (the separate agent's driver); the application of the REGISTERED normalisers saea-deliver-normalise-v4 / -v4g to a sealed column is scripts/analysis/slurp_nx_postproc_v4_apply.py --apply v4|v4g --pool <run>/<attempt> [--column <arm id>] (on master since merge 7bfc09b3b). KNOWN BLOCKER: that driver refuses any run whose roster intersects TRAIN Fold B ('Fold B is not read by this script'); the R1 run IS Fold B, so the refusal must be lifted for this one recipe before the offline step can run (nx_r1_read.sh reports it and exits 10 rather than skipping silently)

lock_rule_row.rule: The R1 delivering-arm (lock) column on TRAIN Fold B is the FRESH CONFIRMATION roster for v4g (the guards were derived from Fold A and A2 attribution, so neither can confirm them): lock v4g iff the CI95 lower bound of the paired pooled SLU-F1 delta is above 0 here.

offline_columns.note: 0 GPU, zero model contacts. Two deterministic delivery-normaliser variants applied OFFLINE to every arm's delivered column; the cell's runtime delivery normaliser stays the COMP-1b module cell's (saea-deliver-normalise-v3) and neither variant is wired into the cell.

review_off_vs_full_graph.contrast: the delivering lock arm of this flight (review-off, Fold B) vs the P-SV-3 a-agree DELIVERED column on the same Fold B
review_off_vs_full_graph.offset_bound: the P-SV-3 t-twin offset (flight offset between two identical-request flights)
review_off_vs_full_graph.rule: If the lock arm minus the P-SV-3 a-agree delivered column is within the bar (2.5 pp; the P-SV-3 t-twin offset reported beside as the flight-offset bound), review-off is locked (owner decision 232 / programme F2); if the full graph wins by more than 1.49 pp SLU with CI95 lower bound > 0 the drop is revisited. Cross-flight and therefore never a gating number of this flight's column read.

steps: 0. Refuse unless the READ row SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-NX-R1-SOLVER-FOLD-B-COLUMN-READ-V1 is root countersigned.

1. Refuse unless the flight carries a COMPLETE sealed 1,080-row manifest with one complete official TRAIN score and the saea-supply-variant-arms-v4 receipt on every row, verified by the bundle (invariant I7v).

2. Node-local (E2): per arm raw parse validity, entity exact-set, empty-gold false fill, non-empty exact and per-slot-type counts, paired per row against lock, whole-utterance bootstrap and paired Wilson.
3. Official: render each arm's first-visit Solver answer through the delivered row's normaliser and projection and score it ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train (seven jobs, never sharded).
4. Twin null (aa vs lock) first, then each candidate vs lock under the rule; per-scenario tables.
5. Offline v4 / v4g columns over every arm's delivered column (0 GPU), the lock row v4g(lock) - lock being the v4g confirmation.
6. The review-off vs full-graph comparison against the P-SV-3 a-agree delivered column (cross-flight; no extra flight).
